title: lidge-jun/opencodex
claim: lidge-jun/opencodex — Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code — use any LLM (Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama…) with Cod
why_good: A universal proxy that points OpenAI Codex / Claude Code at ANY model — Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, local Ollama — decoupling the best coding-agent UX from a single vendor's model and pricing. Strong, immediate developer pull.
value: Sits between every coding-agent seat and the model: become the team gateway for model routing, spend control, observability and BYO-model — the layer companies pay to manage agent LLM cost.
risk: Vendors may lock their clients to block proxies; a thin proxy commoditizes unless it owns routing + observability.
